verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents webhooks and an Events API for Directory Sync, so directory user, group and access-rule changes can be pushed to or pulled by your app (workos-supp-scim-webhooks, workos-docs-21). Audit-log streaming to SIEMs is also offered (workos-supp-radar). However, nothing in the pack shows webhook or event coverage for AuthKit authentication events such as sign-ups and sign-ins. Missing for 10: documented webhook/event types for sign-up, sign-in and AuthKit user changes; webhook delivery details (signing, retries); independent or hands-on corroboration.
